title: CHAPTER XIX. A Concert a Catastrophe and a Confession

paragraphs.en: Anne ran down from the east gable one February evening, asking Marilla if she could visit Diana for just a minute. Marilla, dismissive of her request, noted that they had already walked home together and stood in the snow for half an hour after school.
paragraphs.zh: 安妮在一个二月的傍晚从东面的山墙跑下来，请求玛丽拉能否让她去戴安娜家待一会儿。玛丽拉不以为意地回应说她们已经一起走回家了，在放学后还站在雪地里等了半个多小时。

paragraphs.en: "But she wants to see me," Anne pleaded. "She has something very important to tell me."
paragraphs.zh: “但她想见我，”安妮央求道，“她有非常重要的话要告诉我。”

paragraphs.en: "How do you know?" Marilla asked skeptically.
paragraphs.zh: “你怎么知道的？”玛丽拉怀疑地问道。

paragraphs.en: "Because she signaled from her window using our candle and cardboard signals," Anne explained. "Two flashes mean 'Are you there?' Three mean 'yes,' four 'no,' and five means 'Come over as soon as possible because I have something important to reveal.'
paragraphs.zh: “因为我从窗户里用我们的蜡烛和纸板信号发出了信号，”安妮解释道，“两闪代表‘你在吗？’三闪表示‘是的’，四闪则是‘不’，而五闪意味着‘尽快过来，我有重要的事情要告诉你。’”

paragraphs.en: Diana sent me five flashes."
paragraphs.zh: 戴安娜给我发了五条消息。

paragraphs.en: Marilla grudgingly allowed Anne to go but insisted she return in ten minutes.
paragraphs.zh: 玛丽拉勉强答应让安妮去，但坚持让她十分钟内回来。

paragraphs.en: Anne returned on time, excited about Diana's invitation. "Tomorrow is Diana's birthday," she said. "Her mother told her she could ask me to stay all night and that her cousins would come from Newbridge for the Debating Club concert at the hall.
paragraphs.zh: 安妮按时返回，兴奋地谈起戴安娜的邀请。“明天是戴安娜的生日，”她说，“她妈妈告诉我可以留宿一晚，而且她的表兄弟姐妹们会从纽布里奇赶来参加大厅里的辩论俱乐部音乐会。”

paragraphs.en: They want us to go together if you'll let me."
paragraphs.zh: “如果你不介意的话，我们一起去吧。”

paragraphs.en: Marilla refused Anne's request, saying she should be home in bed and that girls shouldn't attend such events.
paragraphs.zh: 玛丽拉拒绝了安妮的请求，说她应该待在家里上床休息，并且女孩子不应该参加这样的活动。

paragraphs.en: Anne argued, "The Debating Club is a respectable affair."
paragraphs.zh: 安妮争辩道：“辩论俱乐部是一项正经事。”

paragraphs.en: Anne was on the verge of tears as she pleaded with Marilla. "It’s such a special occasion," she said, her voice trembling. "Diana has only one birthday in a year.
paragraphs.zh: 安妮几乎要哭出声来，她恳求玛丽拉道：“这真是一个特别的日子啊，”她的声音微微颤抖，“戴安娜一年只有一个生日。

paragraphs.en: Prissy Andrews will recite 'Curfew Must Not Ring Tonight,' and the choir will sing four lovely songs. And the minister is going to give an address—almost like a sermon."
paragraphs.zh: 普里西·安德鲁斯将朗诵《今夜钟声不应响》，合唱团将会演唱四首美妙的歌曲。而牧师还要发表一段讲演——几乎像是一篇布道词。

paragraphs.en: Marilla remained firm. "You heard what I said, Anne. It’s past eight, and you’re going to bed now."
paragraphs.zh: 玛丽拉态度坚决：“安妮，你听见我说的话了。都快八点了，你现在得上床睡觉。”

paragraphs.en: Anne tried one last time. "Mrs. Barry told Diana that we might sleep in the spare-room bed," she said, her voice filled with hope.
paragraphs.zh: 安妮试了一次最后的希望：“巴里太太告诉戴安娜，我们可能会睡在那张多余的床上。”她的话中充满了期待。

paragraphs.en: "Go to bed, Anne," Marilla replied sternly. "Don’t let me hear another word from you."
paragraphs.zh: “去睡觉，安妮，”玛丽拉严厉地说，“别让我再听到你说话。”

paragraphs.en: As Anne went upstairs, tears streaming down her face, Matthew woke up on the lounge. He spoke decisively. "Marilla, I think you should let Anne go."
paragraphs.zh: 安妮流着泪走上楼，马修在沙发上醒来，果断地说：“玛丽拉，我觉得你应该让安妮去。”

paragraphs.en: Marilla retorted, "I don't agree." She challenged, "Who’s bringing this child up—me or you?"
paragraphs.zh: 玛丽拉反驳道：“我不同意。”她质问道：“抚养这个孩子的是我，还是你？”

paragraphs.en: Matthew admitted, "It's you."
paragraphs.zh: 马修脱口而出，“就是你。”

paragraphs.en: "Then don’t interfere," Marilla said.
paragraphs.zh: “那你不要干涉了,”玛丽拉说。

paragraphs.en: Matthew replied, "I’m not interfering. It’s fine to have my own opinion. And mine is that you should let Anne go."
paragraphs.zh: 马修回答道：“我可没干涉。有自己看法本没错。我的看法是，你应该让安妮去。”

paragraphs.en: Marilla responded amiably but firmly, "If she wanted to spend the night on the moon, I’d probably let her. But I don't approve of this concert plan. She might catch a cold and be filled with nonsense and excitement for a week."
paragraphs.zh: 玛丽拉友好的但坚决地回答：“如果她想在月亮上过夜，我大概也会让她去。不过我不赞成这个音乐会的计划。她可能会着凉生病，一个星期都沉浸在感冒和兴奋之中。”

paragraphs.en: Matthew insisted Marilla should let Anne go. Marilla reluctantly agreed but said sharply, "Fine, she can leave if you're satisfied." Anne rushed out of the pantry, holding her dripping dishcloth.
paragraphs.zh: 马修坚持让玛丽拉放安妮去。虽然有些不情愿，玛丽拉还是勉强同意了，并尖锐地说：“好啊，如果你满意的话她就可以走了。”安妮急忙从餐具柜里冲了出来，手里还拿着湿漉漉的抹布。

paragraphs.en: "Oh, Marilla, Marilla, say it again."
paragraphs.zh: “哦，玛丽拉，玛丽拉，再说一遍。”

paragraphs.en: "Enough," Marilla replied, "it's Matthew's idea. Don't blame me for his doing. If you get sick from sleeping in a strange bed or coming home late, don't complain to me."
paragraphs.zh: “够了，”玛丽拉说道，“这是马修的想法。别怪我替他承担。如果你因为睡在陌生的床上或是回家太晚而生病，可别找我抱怨。”

paragraphs.en: She added, "Anne, stop dripping water on the floor and clean up before school."
paragraphs.zh: 她补充道：“安妮，别再往地上滴水了，上学前把地板擦干净。”

paragraphs.en: Anne felt guilty but explained, "I know I'm a bother, Marilla. But think of all the mistakes I avoid. Matthew understands me, which is wonderful."
paragraphs.zh: 安妮感到内疚，但她解释说：“我知道自己添麻烦了，玛丽拉。但想想我避免了多少错误。马修理解我，这真是太好了。”

paragraphs.en: That morning at school, Anne was too excited about the concert to perform well. Gilbert Blythe outperformed her in spelling and arithmetic. However, with the upcoming concert and spare room bed, she and Diana talked incessantly about it, sparing her from further embarrassment under a stricter teacher.
paragraphs.zh: 那天早上，在学校里，安妮因为即将举行的音乐会兴奋得无法集中精力，成绩不佳。吉尔伯特·布莱斯在拼写和算术方面表现超过了她。不过，随着音乐会的临近和额外床位的到来，她与戴安娜不停地讨论此事，这让她在更严格的老师面前免去了更多的尴尬。

paragraphs.en: Anne was thrilled by the prospect of attending the concert, which overshadowed all other topics at school. The Avonlea Debating Club had organized this event, with admission priced at ten cents for a library fundraiser. For weeks, young people from Avonlea had been rehearsing, and Anne, along with her classmates, eagerly anticipated the evening.
paragraphs.zh: 安妮对参加音乐会的前景感到兴奋，这使得学校里其他话题都相形见绌。埃文利辩论俱乐部组织了这场活动，门票十美分，是为了图书馆筹款。几周以来，埃文利的年轻人一直在排练，安妮和她的同学们也满怀期待地等待着那个晚上到来。

paragraphs.en: The excitement built as they left school, reaching its peak during their preparations. Anne and Diana practiced various hairstyles in Diana's room, experimenting with different looks until they were ready. Despite her plain attire—black tam and homemade gray coat—Anne felt a pang of self-consciousness but reminded herself to use her imagination.
paragraphs.zh: 随着她们离开学校，兴奋的情绪逐渐升高，在准备阶段达到了顶点。安妮和戴安娜在戴安娜的房间里尝试各种发型，不断变换造型直到满意为止。尽管穿着朴素——一顶黑色的帽子和一件自制的灰色外套——安妮还是感到有些自我意识上的波动，但她提醒自己要用想象力来弥补。

paragraphs.en: Diana’s cousins from Newbridge arrived, filling the pung sleigh with laughter and chatter as they journeyed to the hall. Anne reveled in the smooth ride over the snow-covered roads, enjoying the vibrant sunset that bathed the snowy hills and deep-blue St. Lawrence Gulf in a magical glow. The tinkling of sleigh bells and distant mirthful laughter added to the enchantment.
paragraphs.zh: 戴安娜的纽伯里表亲们乘坐雪橇抵达，一路上欢声笑语不断。她们前往大厅的路上，安妮享受着在白雪覆盖的道路上的平稳旅程，欣赏着夕阳将雪坡和深蓝色圣劳伦斯海湾染成一片魔幻般的光芒。叮当作响的铃铛声和远处传来的愉快笑声更增添了这份魔力。

paragraphs.en: "Isn't it all like a beautiful dream?" Anne whispered to Diana, squeezing her hand under the fur robe. "Do I really look different tonight?"
paragraphs.zh: “这不是如同一场美丽的梦境吗？”安妮压低声音对戴安娜耳语，一边在皮毛披风下握住了她的手。“我今晚真的看起来不一样了吗？”

paragraphs.en: Diana reassured her, saying, "You look lovely," passing on a compliment she had just received from a cousin.
paragraphs.zh: 戴安娜宽慰她说：“你看起来真漂亮。”她刚刚从表姐那里得到了这样的赞美。

paragraphs.en: That night’s concert was thrilling for Anne, each piece more exciting than the last. As Prissy Andrews ascended the dark ladder adorned in pink silk and pearls, Anne shivered with sympathy. When the choir sang "Far Above the Gentle Daisies," she gazed at the ceiling as if it were painted with angels.
paragraphs.zh: 那个晚上，音乐会令安妮兴奋不已，每一首曲子都比前一首更激动人心。当普西·安德鲁斯身着粉丝绸和珍珠，在黑暗的梯子上缓缓上升时，安妮不禁为她感到同情。当合唱团演唱《远在温柔雏菊之上》时，安妮的目光仿佛被天花板上的天使所吸引。

paragraphs.en: Sam Sloane’s humorous explanation of "How Sockery Set a Hen" had Anne laughing uncontrollably, even those nearby joined in out of shared amusement. Mr. Phillips delivered Mark Antony's oration with such passion that Anne felt like mutinying, especially when he looked at Prissy Andrews after each sentence.
paragraphs.zh: 萨姆·斯洛恩对“如何用袜子给母鸡做手术”的幽默解释让安妮笑得前仰后合，周围的人都被她的笑声感染，跟着笑了起来。菲利普先生以如此激情演绎了马克·安东尼的演讲，以至于安妮觉得简直想叛乱，尤其是在他每说完一句话就看向普西·安德鲁斯的时候。

paragraphs.en: The only piece that failed to interest her was Gilbert Blythe’s recitation of "Bingen on the Rhine." Anne read Rhoda Murray’s book until he finished. Then she sat stiff and motionless as Diana clapped until her hands tingled.
paragraphs.zh: 唯一让她不感兴趣的是吉尔伯特·布莱斯朗读的《莱茵河上的宾根》。安妮一直读着罗达·默里的书，直到他朗读完毕。然后，在戴安娜鼓掌的时候，她僵硬地坐着，直到手掌感到有些发麻。

paragraphs.en: They returned home at eleven, exhausted but eager to discuss their evening. The house was dark and silent; everyone seemed asleep. Anne and Diana tiptoed into the parlor, a warm and dimly lit room.
paragraphs.zh: 他们十一点钟左右回到家，虽然疲惫不堪，但迫不及待地想要讨论晚上的活动。屋内一片漆黑寂静，大家都似乎已经睡下。安妮和戴安娜轻手轻脚地走进客厅，那是一个温暖而昏暗的房间。

paragraphs.en: "Let's undress here," suggested Diana. "It’s so cozy."
paragraphs.zh: “我们在这里更衣吧，”戴安娜建议道，“这里真是温馨 comfy。”

paragraphs.en: "It must have been wonderful to recite there," sighed Anne. "Do you think we'll ever be asked?"
paragraphs.zh: “能在那儿朗诵一定很美妙吧，”安妮叹了口气，“你觉得我们会被邀请吗？”

paragraphs.en: "Yes, of course," replied Diana. "They always want big scholars like Gilbert Blythe. He often does it and he’s only two years older than us.
paragraphs.zh: “当然，”戴安娜回答，“他们总是喜欢像吉尔伯特·布莱斯这样的大个子学者。他经常这么做，而且他比我们大两岁而已。”

paragraphs.en: How could you pretend not to listen when he said,
paragraphs.zh: 他一说，你怎么能装作没听见？

paragraphs.en: ‘THERE'S ANOTHER, NOT A SISTER’?
paragraphs.zh: “还有一个，不是姐妹？”

paragraphs.en: He looked right at you."
paragraphs.zh: 他直勾勾地盯着你。

paragraphs.en: With dignity, Anne responded, "Diana, my dear friend, I cannot discuss that with you. Are you ready for bed? Let's race to see who gets there first."
paragraphs.zh: 安妮庄重地回答：“戴安娜，我亲爱的朋友，这件事我们不宜讨论。你准备睡觉了吗？咱们来个比赛，看谁先到床上。”

paragraphs.en: Anne and Diana were thrilled by the idea. They raced down the long room, through the spare-room door, and leaped onto the bed simultaneously. Suddenly, something moved beneath them, causing a gasp and cry: "Merciful goodness!"
paragraphs.zh: 安妮和戴安娜对这个想法兴奋不已。她们飞快地穿过长长的房间，从备用房的门闯了进去，同时跳上了床。突然间，床上似乎有什么东西动了一下，两人不由得倒吸一口凉气，齐声惊呼：“天哪！”

paragraphs.en: The girls managed to escape the room in a panic, tiptoeing shiveringly upstairs. Anne whispered, "Who was it—WHAT was it?" with chattering teeth.
paragraphs.zh: 女孩们慌乱中逃出了房间，蹑手蹑脚地颤巍巍地上了楼。安妮低声问道：“是谁——到底是什么？”牙齿打着战。

paragraphs.en: "It was Aunt Josephine," said Diana, laughing. "She must have come earlier than expected. She'll be furious, but did you ever know anything so funny?"
paragraphs.zh: 戴安娜笑着说道：“是乔赛亚姨妈。”“她一定是比预期早到了。她肯定会大发雷霆，但你有见过这么有趣的事情吗？”

paragraphs.en: "Who is your Aunt Josephine?" asked Anne curiously.
paragraphs.zh: “你的乔斯林阿姨是谁？”安妮好奇地问道。

paragraphs.en: "She's father’s aunt and lives in Charlottetown. She’s very old—seventy at least—and never was a little girl. We were expecting her for a visit, but not this soon.
paragraphs.zh: “她是爸爸的姑妈，住在夏洛特镇。她年纪很大了——至少七十岁了，并且从来不是个孩子。我们本指望她会来拜访，但没想到这么快。”

paragraphs.en: She’s strict and will scold us about this. Minnie May kicks terribly."
paragraphs.zh: 她向来严厉，肯定会因此责备我们的。还有，米妮·梅的脚踢得可厉害了。

paragraphs.en: Miss Josephine Barry did not appear at breakfast the next morning. Mrs. Barry smiled kindly at Anne and Diana. "Did you have fun last night?
paragraphs.zh: 乔斯林·巴里小姐第二天早上没有出现在早餐桌上。巴里太太慈祥地冲安妮和戴安娜笑了笑：“你们昨晚玩得开心吗？”

paragraphs.en: I tried to stay awake until your return, but fell asleep. I hope you didn't disturb Aunt Josephine, Diana."
paragraphs.zh: 我试图等到你回来再睡，但还是不知不觉地睡着了。希望 Didn’t 扰醒约瑟芬姑妈和戴安娜。

paragraphs.en: Diana remained silent, but Anne and Diana exchanged guilty smiles. Anne rushed home after breakfast, unaware of the commotion that followed.
paragraphs.zh: 戴安娜没有说话，但安妮和戴安娜交换了一个心照不宣的微笑。安妮早餐后匆匆回家，全然不知随后将要发生的一系列风波。

paragraphs.en: Mrs. Lynde later revealed, "You and Diana nearly scared poor Miss Barry to death last night?" she said with a twinkle in her eye. "Mrs. Barry was worried about it.
paragraphs.zh: 雷切尔·林德夫人后来透露：“你们俩昨晚差点把巴里小姐吓死吗？”她眼里闪烁着光芒，“巴里太太为此很担心呢。”

paragraphs.en: Old Miss Barry was in a terrible mood this morning, and Josephine’s temper is no joke."
paragraphs.zh: 老巴里太太今天早上心情糟糕透了，乔西琳的脾气可不好惹。

paragraphs.en: Anne admitted, "It wasn't Diana's fault. I suggested racing to see who would get into bed first."
paragraphs.zh: 安妮承认道：“这不能怪戴安娜。是我提议比赛看谁先上床的。”

paragraphs.en: Mrs. Lynde confirmed her suspicions, declaring that Anne's idea caused trouble. Old Miss Barry, who had planned to stay for a month, decided to leave immediately due to Diana's behavior during music lessons. Mrs. Lynde speculated on the conflict between the Barrys and their financial situation.
paragraphs.zh: 玛丽拉确认了自己的怀疑，宣称安妮的想法引发了麻烦。原本计划逗留一个月的老巴里小姐因为戴安娜在音乐课上的表现决定立即离开。玛丽拉还推测起巴里一家的矛盾以及他们的财务状况。

paragraphs.en: Anne lamented her misfortunes, feeling responsible not only for her own mistakes but also for involving her friends in trouble. She asked Mrs. Lynde why this kept happening.
paragraphs.zh: 安妮为自己的不幸而哀叹，不仅觉得自己应该为自己的错误负责，还觉得连累了朋友陷入困境。她向雷切尔·林德太太询问，为什么总是这样。

paragraphs.en: Mrs. Lynde blamed Anne's impulsiveness, advising her to think before acting. Anne disagreed, arguing that spontaneity was the best part of her nature.
paragraphs.zh: 雷切尔·林德夫人批评安妮的冲动行为，建议她在行动前多加思考。但安妮不同意这一观点，认为 spontaneity 是她性格中最精彩的部分。

paragraphs.en: Mrs. Lynde laughed at her joke about thinking before leaping into spare-room beds, but Anne remained serious. She walked across the fields to Orchard Slope and found Diana waiting at the kitchen door.
paragraphs.zh: 雷切尔·林德太太听了安妮关于跳入空房间之前要三思而行的笑话后笑出了声，但安妮依然神情严肃。她穿过田地走向果园坡，发现戴安娜正站在厨房门口等着她。

paragraphs.en: Diana whispered that Aunt Josephine had been furious, scolding Diana harshly for her behavior during the lessons. Anne pressed Diana to admit it was her fault, but Diana insisted she didn't care about staying or going.
paragraphs.zh: 戴安娜低声道，乔斯林姑妈大发雷霆，严厉批评她在课上的表现。安妮催促戴安娜承认错误是她的责任，但戴安娜坚持认为自己不在乎是否留下或离开。

paragraphs.en: Anne stood firm, determined to confess her mistake. "It's likely I'd do such a thing," she said with disdain, adding, "I'm no telltale, Anne Shirley, and anyhow I was just as much to blame as you."
paragraphs.zh: 安妮坚定地站在那里，决心承认自己的错误。“我干这种事倒是很有可能，”她带着不屑的语气说道，“我可不是爱告密的人，安妮·肖礼，并且说到底，我也跟你一样有责任。”

paragraphs.en: "Alright, I'll go in myself," Anne declared resolutely.
paragraphs.zh: “我自己进去吧，”安妮坚决地说。

paragraphs.en: Diana stared, shocked. "Anne Shirley, you wouldn't! She'll eat you alive!"
paragraphs.zh: 戴安娜惊呆了，脱口而出：“安妮·夏利，你不会！她会把你吃得一点不剩！”

paragraphs.en: "Don't frighten me more than I am," pleaded Anne. "I'd rather face a cannon's mouth. But I must do this, Diana.
paragraphs.zh: “别再吓我了，我已经够紧张的了。”安妮恳求道，“与其面对大炮的口门，我还愿意呢。但这件事我必须去做，戴安娜。

paragraphs.en: It was my fault and I have to confess."
paragraphs.zh: 这都是我的错，我得承认。

paragraphs.en: Miss Josephine Barry sat rigidly by the fire, knitting fiercely, her eyes flashing through her glasses. Anne knocked gently on the door. "Come in," came the sharp reply.
paragraphs.zh: 乔斯林·巴里小姐紧挨着火炉坐着，用力地织着毛衣，眼镜后的眼睛透过镜片闪烁着。安妮轻轻敲了敲门。“进来吧，”里面传来尖锐的声音。

paragraphs.en: Anne entered, finding Miss Barry stern and unyielding. The older woman's face turned towards her, expecting Diana but seeing a pale girl with wide, fearful eyes.
paragraphs.zh: 安妮推门而入，发现巴里小姐神情严峻，毫不妥协。那张成熟的脸转向她，本以为会看到戴安娜，却看到了一个面色苍白、眼神恐惧的女孩。

paragraphs.en: "Who are you?" demanded Miss Barry without ceremony.
paragraphs.zh: “你是谁？”巴里小姐不客气地问道。

paragraphs.en: "I'm Anne of Green Gables," Anne trembled, clasping her hands in her characteristic gesture. "I've come to confess."
paragraphs.zh: “我是绿山墙的安妮，”安妮颤抖着，做了她标志性的双手相扣的动作，“我来承认一些事情。”

paragraphs.en: "Confess what?"
paragraphs.zh: “你要承认什么呢？”

paragraphs.en: "That it was all my fault about jumping into bed on you last night. I suggested it. Diana would never have thought of such a thing, Miss Barry.
paragraphs.zh: “这一切都是我的错，昨晚让你跳进被窝里。是我提的建议。戴安娜绝不会想到这样的事情，巴里小姐。”

paragraphs.en: She's very ladylike."
paragraphs.zh: 她举止十分得体。

paragraphs.en: "Oh, must I forgive? I think Diana did her share too," said Miss Barry, still severe.
paragraphs.zh: “哦，我必须原谅吗？我觉得戴安娜也做得够多了，”巴里小姐依然板着脸说道。

paragraphs.en: "But we were only in fun," Anne persisted. "Please forgive us now that we've apologized. And please let Diana have her music lessons.
paragraphs.zh: “但我们只是开个玩笑而已，”安妮坚持道，“我们已经道歉了，请原谅我们吧。而且，请允许戴安娜继续她的音乐课。”

paragraphs.en: Her heart is set on them, and I know how it feels to want something so much."
paragraphs.zh: 她的心思全在上面，我知道那种渴望得如此强烈的感受。

paragraphs.en: By this time, the old lady's sternness softened slightly, replaced by a twinkle of amusement. But she still said firmly:
paragraphs.zh: 到这时，老妇人的严厉表情稍微柔和了一些，取而代之的是一丝 amusement 的光芒。但她仍然坚定地说：

paragraphs.en: Anne explained to Miss Barry about the incident where Diana and she had bounced onto her bed after a long journey. She emphasized how disturbing it was for them, especially since they couldn't sleep in the spare room afterward.
paragraphs.zh: 安妮向巴里小姐解释了戴安娜和她长途跋涉后跳上她的床铺所发生的那一幕。她强调这对她们来说非常不安，特别是之后她们无法在客房中入睡。

paragraphs.en: Miss Barry laughed, much to Diana's relief outside in the kitchen. She admitted that her imagination was rusty but agreed Anne’s case deserved sympathy.
paragraphs.zh: 巴里小姐在外厨房里笑了，这让戴安娜松了一口气。她承认自己的想象力有些生疏，但还是同意安妮的情况值得同情。

paragraphs.en: Anne insisted on returning home to Miss Marilla Cuthbert, who had taken care of her properly. Despite this duty, she hoped Miss Barry would forgive Diana and stay longer in Avonlea.
paragraphs.zh: 安妮坚持要回家去找玛丽拉·库伯小姐，因为她曾好好照顾过自己。尽管如此，她还是希望巴里小姐能原谅戴安娜，并且多在埃文利待几天。

paragraphs.en: Miss Barry offered to talk occasionally with Anne if she stayed. That evening, Miss Barry gave Diana a silver bracelet and told the household she was unpacking her valise. She stated that she planned to stay just for better acquaintance with Anne, as amusing people were rare at her age.
paragraphs.zh: 巴里小姐提出，如果安妮留下来的话，她可以偶尔与安妮交谈。当天晚上，巴里小姐送给戴安娜一只银手镯，并告诉全家人她正在整理行李箱，打算留下与安妮更好地熟悉一下，因为有趣的人在她这个年纪可不多见。

paragraphs.en: Marilla responded with, "I told you so," for Matthew's sake.
paragraphs.zh: 为了马修的缘故，玛丽拉回应说：“我早就告诉过你了。”

paragraphs.en: Anne and Miss Barry became close friends during her extended stay. Anne found Miss Barry more pleasant than usual, keeping her in high spirits.
paragraphs.zh: 安妮和巴里小姐在她长时间逗留期间成了亲密朋友。安妮觉得巴里小姐比平时更加随和，这让她的精神一直都很振奋。

paragraphs.en: Before leaving, Miss Barry said, "Remember to visit me when you're in town, and I'll put you in my spare room."
paragraphs.zh: 巴里小姐临走时说：“你下次来埃文利镇的时候记得来看我，我会让你住在我空余的房间。”

paragraphs.en: Anne shared with Marilla, "Miss Barry is a kindred spirit, despite her appearance. It takes time to see it, but there are many such souls in the world."
paragraphs.zh: 安妮对玛丽拉说：“巴里小姐虽外表严厉，但本质上与我志趣相投。要真正了解她需要时间，但这世上有许多这样的心灵相通的人。”
